description: Builder sample coin_rush: markers, random coins, pickup score, finish

steps.script:
-- Coin Rush
--
-- A tiny example mode: collect 10 coins by walking over them.
-- Demonstrates markers, scores, randomness and finishing a round.

local target_score = 10
local coin_count = 6
local pickup_radius = 26

local function spawn_coin()
  local world = lb.world()
  lb.spawn_marker(
    lb.random(40, world.width - 40),
    lb.random(40, world.height - 40),
    "+1",
    "coin"
  )
end

function on_start()
  lb.log("Collect " .. target_score .. " coins. WASD to move.")
  for _ = 1, coin_count do
    spawn_coin()
  end
end

function on_tick(dt)
  local me = lb.player("p-local")
  if me == nil or lb.is_finished() then
    return
  end

  for _, marker in ipairs(lb.markers()) do
    if marker.kind == "coin" then
      local dx = marker.x - me.x
      local dy = marker.y - me.y
      if dx * dx + dy * dy <= pickup_radius * pickup_radius then
        lb.remove_marker(marker.id)
        lb.add_score("p-local", 1)

        local score = lb.player("p-local").score
        lb.log("Coin collected (" .. score .. "/" .. target_score .. ")")

        if score >= target_score then
          lb.finish("p-local")
          return
        end
        spawn_coin()
      end
    end
  end
end

function on_finish(winner)
  lb.log("Round over. Winner: " .. tostring(winner))
end
